Content inside <template> is never rendered per the HTML spec and must not appear in the output

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const html_to_markdown_rs = @import("html_to_markdown_rs");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _result_json = try html_to_markdown_rs.convert("<p>visible</p><template><p>secret template text</p></template><p>also visible</p>", null);
    defer std.heap.c_allocator.free(_result_json);
    std.debug.print("{s}\n", .{_result_json});

}
```
